apiContract.uniqueInfo: Ordinary proc_pidinfo flavor17, arg0; 56 bytes and errno0; checked ctypes layout, nonzero uniqueid/UUID and zero reserved fields
apiContract.candidateBinding: Two complete BSD five-tuple reads with stable PPID/PGID; two matching uniqueid/parent-uniqueid/idversion/original-parent-version/UUID reads
apiContract.pidOneBinding: Two primary KERN_PROC PID1 birth/credential tuples and two matching flavor17 results; root EUID/RUID required
apiContract.signedVersions: Signed int32 supported; positivity not assumed
apiContract.primaryCensus: include_pid_one defaults false; optional PID1 metadata does not add root identities to worker candidates
apiContract.failureBehavior: Denied, short, missing, changed or invalid optional observations remain diagnostic-unavailable; no privilege or alternate API fallback

control.sequence: Exact Popen supervisor -> forked child -> supervisor exit -> orphan reparent -> orphan exec
control.requiredNegative: After orphan exec, parent uniqueid matches PID1 while original-parent version remains the supervisor version; classification must remain original-parent-not-established
control.orphanLifetime: Dedicated pipe EOF or per-image 30-second self-expiry; exec begins a new self-expiry interval
control.signalScope: Only exact Popen supervisor; no signal to arbitrary PID or adopted orphan
control.cleanup: Close pipe, bounded exact supervisor wait/termination, separate group-gone check; failure remains unverified and fails the experiment
control.primaryFailure: Original failure survives additional cleanup failure; otherwise cleanup failure becomes a fixed Failure
control.environment: Explicit clean environment; unrelated job environment not inherited
control.stageObservation: Origin-control hints use no invented sampler history

privacy.publicData: Fixed classifications/booleans/counts/API byte lengths and errno only
privacy.metadataCoverage: Unavailable role classifications counted separately from verified metadata-worker candidates
